routing_constraints.requirement: Parker271-6 catalog minimum45mm; nominalOD19mm andID10mm. Check curve radius through articulated motion, not just static view.
routing_constraints.limit: Catalog rounded values do not specify tolerances or this rail flex duty.

routing_constraints.requirement: Provide movement and vibration allowance without tension or excessive loops that can snag or rub.
routing_constraints.limit: Pressure length-change data for exact271-6 assembly remains missing; constant-length geometry is a screening scenario.

routing_constraints.requirement: Separate compound motion into supported planar flex sections; avoid twist from assembly and machine motion.
routing_constraints.limit: A three-dimensional centreline can clear solids while hose material twists. Combinedyaw/roll clearance does not establish orientation or fatigue acceptance.

routing_constraints.requirement: Avoid sharp bending at fitting; manufacturer consultation required for minimum free hose length.
routing_constraints.limit: No exact271-6/25Series minimum straight lead was found.70mm or116mm modeled leads are design scenarios, not catalog minima.

routing_constraints.requirement: 319-SA87-H is a smooth19mm hose sliding guide without initial tension.
routing_constraints.limit: It provides lateral guidance, not rated axial or torsional anchoring. Do not substitute319-SA87 profiled fixed pipe clamp.

routing_constraints.requirement: 17B25 allows assembly/disconnection without turning the whole hose.
routing_constraints.limit: No live rotary-union rating was obtained; do not credit rotation during vehicle motion.

routing_constraints.requirement: Keep hose separated from abrasive structure and from other hoses. Protection must not create a new rubbing edge or restrain necessary length change.
routing_constraints.limit: Custom guard dimensions/welds are proposed hardware, not manufacturer-approved protection.

routing_constraints.requirement: Keep both lines individually traceable by physicalPORT97/PORT116. Retain accessible unions and guide-cap bolts.
routing_constraints.limit: Service/parking assignment and upstream valves remain unresolved; no pressurized disconnect or maintenance procedure is authorized.

catalog_protection_options_not_selected.status: Catalog suggests both for271-6 by OD. Installed exterior, retention and effect on flex/bend radius are not established. No sleeve is added to the nominal hose silently.

qualification_boundaries: SAEJ1402A/DOTFMVSS106 air-brake catalog description is not an approval of this rail coach, body-to-truck motion, brake kit or completed hose assembly.
Manufacturer mounting dimensions can support a drawing while complete mating, pressure, assembly and motion performance remains unaccepted.
Parker25Series machine-specific crimp spec, actualcutlength/insertion and end clocking require confirmation; prior C56 reference depth22.225mm is not a production release.
Two dimensional lines do not establish anti-compounding, supply redundancy, isolation or a trainwide air-brake circuit.
Brake force, rotor interface and exact chamber mapping remain unchanged pending Webb/ZF reply.
